events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence (Art Exhibition)
events.datetime: Ongoing until Sun 12 Jul, open daily
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: A Brisbane-exclusive exhibition by Olafur Eliasson spanning three decades, offering a multi-sensory journey through perception and inviting reflection on the future of our cities.

events.title: 136th Royal Queensland Art Society's Members Annual Art Exhibition
events.datetime: Ongoing until Sun 5 Jul, Wed-Sun 10:00 AM – 3:30 PM
events.description: The Royal Queensland Art Society's annual exhibition showcasing diverse talent and creativity from its members across various art forms at the Petrie Terrace Gallery.

events.title: RQAS Life Drawing Sessions
events.description: A hands-on life drawing workshop run by the Royal Queensland Art Society, offering an opportunity for artists to practice and develop their drawing skills in a studio setting.

events.title: The Explainer Series: First Nations Astronomy
events.description: An intellectually stimulating talk from 'The Explainer Series' exploring Indigenous knowledge systems and perspectives related to astronomy and the cosmos.

events.title: First Nations Art Tours
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Guided tours at GOMA offering cultural insights and discussion focused on the gallery's collection of First Nations art, providing deeper context and understanding.

events.title: The Gesualdo Six – Wishing Tree
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Bank
events.description: An intimate musical performance by The Gesualdo Six, presenting their 'Wishing Tree' program, offering a high artistic value vocal experience.

events.title: 360 ALLSTARS
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Bank
events.description: A high-energy, contemporary performance blending BMX, basketball, breakdancing, beatboxing, and other urban art forms into a dynamic live show.

events.title: PRAMKICKER by Sadie Hasler
events.location: Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Bank
events.source: QPAC (presented by a Brisbane-based feminist theatre collective)
events.description: A theatre production by Sadie Hasler, presented by a local feminist theatre collective, offering a thought-provoking performance focused on contemporary cultural themes.

events.title: BEETLEJUICE THE MUSICAL
events.description: The highly popular Broadway musical adaptation of Beetlejuice, offering a mainstream theatre experience with high production value and comedic elements.

events.title: Carl Donnelly | Another Round (Comedy)
events.location: Good Chat Comedy Club, Petrie Terrace
events.description: Stand-up comedy performance by Carl Donnelly at the intimate Good Chat Comedy Club, offering a chance to see a popular comedian in a local venue.

events.title: SUPERWOG - BIG DADDY ENERGY TOUR
events.description: A live performance from the popular comedy act Superwog on their 'Big Daddy Energy Tour', presented at The Princess Theatre.

events.title: Feid vs Ferxxo: Falxo Tour El Mano a Mano
events.description: A live concert performance featuring Feid vs Ferxxo as part of their 'Falxo Tour El Mano a Mano' at The Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Mt Coot-tha Monday night training walk
events.description: A recurring Monday night training walk around Mt Coot-tha, hosted by Brisbane Bushwalkers, offering a social and active outdoor experience for various fitness levels.
